original_test_intent: Demonstrate the fully populated platform sustains an approved simultaneous full-power CPU, GPU, InfiniBand and E1.S workload at the specified worst-case chamber ambient without thermal warnings, faults, throttling beyond policy or telemetry loss.
original_method: Inventory population/topology and cooling/power configuration; qualify chamber calibration, air orientation, ambient ramp/soak; define concurrent component-specific workloads and utilization/power targets; establish synchronized chamber, BMC, CPU, GPU, NIC, storage, fan, PSU and log telemetry; ramp ambient, start loads, hold the approved soak, enforce hard aborts; stop/cool down in order; verify no alarms/faults/errors and return to stable baseline.
manual_activity: Qualified chamber operator controls ambient/ramp/emergency response; agent may launch approved workloads and collect synchronized telemetry after confirmation.
required_inputs: Exact SUT population, cooling/power mode and chamber/fixture calibration
Worst-case ambient setpoint/tolerance, ramp, stabilization and soak duration
CPU/GPU/IB/E1.S workload commands plus utilization/power targets
Per-sensor warning/fault/throttle/telemetry limits, hard aborts and cooldown/recovery
safety_requirements: Independent chamber/thermal/power monitoring and emergency shutdown
Abort immediately on limit, telemetry loss, cooling/power/component fault or runaway rise
Do not retry at temperature or suppress/clear warnings; controlled cooldown required
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved workload/telemetry manifest and start/stop sequence
Run synchronized loads and record all component/chamber health
Trigger stop on configured abort and preserve raw fault evidence
Do not choose ambient/load/duration, bypass chamber operator, auto-retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve chamber profile and full population/load matrix
Approve utilization/power targets, soak and measurement tolerances
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `stress-ng --cpu 0` loads only CPUs; `nvidia-smi` temperature is observation, not GPU load, and no InfiniBand or E1.S stress is present, so it cannot satisfy full-power all-external-component coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Launch separately approved CPU, GPU, IB traffic and E1.S storage workloads concurrently with verified target mappings and synchronized chamber/BMC/component telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Full power, all external components including InfiniBand/E1.S, worst-case chamber ambient and no thermal warning/fault remain; exact duration is pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a chamber/load state machine with verified per-component power targets, stabilized soak and independent abort controller.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reproducible load coverage, ambient dynamics, synchronized black-box telemetry, hard abort and cooldown.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: CPU-only stress can leave GPUs, NICs and E1.S below thermal design power and cannot validate the platform hot spots named by the source.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Workload power varies by firmware/clocks/data pattern; missing telemetry at high ambient is itself a failure/abort, not evidence of no warning.

project_override_considerations: If external-component maximums cannot occur concurrently by design, engineering must provide the approved worst-case phase matrix and prove equivalent cumulative thermal coverage rather than silently omitting devices.
expected_evidence: Per-component workload command, mapping, utilization and power attainment
Abort/cooldown/final baseline, no-missing-telemetry report and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require full-system worst-case-ambient stress with no thermal warning/fault; missing parameters are engineering inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2287 Wistron-HW-00472-V002: approve full SUT population/cooling/power mode, chamber/fixture/orientation/calibration and worst-case ambient setpoint/tolerance/ramp/stabilization/soak; exact concurrent CPU, GPU, InfiniBand and E1.S workloads, mappings and utilization/power targets; complete thermal/fan/pump/PSU/throttle/error/SEL oracle, hard aborts, telemetry-loss policy, cooldown/recovery and whether phased loads are permitted if concurrency is impossible.

review_improvement: Preserves true all-component full-power chamber coverage and rejects a CPU-only shortcut that would miss the named hot components.
independent_technical_reasoning: Thermal qualification depends on where power is dissipated, not merely total CPU activity. GPU accelerators, NIC optics/ASICs and E1.S devices create different airflow impedances and local hot spots. Querying GPU temperature without loading it cannot establish full-power coverage. Ambient must also be stabilized and measured independently while telemetry completeness is monitored; a lost sensor at high temperature cannot be treated as no warning. The safe run therefore needs explicit simultaneous or approved phased power targets, hard aborts and controlled cooldown.
